entries.title: Manual peak inspection workflow
entries.notes: README-driven workflow for SSH-safe manual ROI inspection and manual peak export.

entries.title: RAFM validation workflow
output_paths: report text under the selected results root
entries.notes: Primary committed replay workflow for bundled RAFM gamma-spectroscopy assets.

entries.title: Phase 6 RAFM worked example
entries.notes: Canonical planning-oriented worked example backed by committed RAFM assets.

entries.title: Unfolding benchmark
entries.notes: Maintained benchmark comparing FluxForge GRAVEL and MLEM results against included reference implementations.

entries.title: Cadmium cover correction demo
output_paths: optional matplotlib figures when enabled by the script
entries.notes: Demonstrates STAYSL-style cadmium cover correction calculations and parity reporting.

entries.title: Complete flux-wire workflow demo
entries.notes: Legacy end-to-end research script that stitches together multiple analysis stages. It uses package-bundled example assets under src/fluxforge/examples rather than top-level example data.

entries.title: Complete NAA workflow demo
input_paths: script-defined synthetic and illustrative k0-NAA parameters
entries.notes: Research walkthrough combining flux characterization and k0-style concentration calculations.

entries.title: ENDF MF33 covariance demo
input_paths: synthetic temporary ENDF-like MF33 section created by the script
entries.notes: Small self-contained demo for covariance parsing, validation, and SVD conditioning.

entries.title: Poisson RMLE gamma unfolding demo
input_paths: synthetic block response and Poisson-sampled spectrum generated by the script
output_paths: stdout solver diagnostics and uncertainty summary
entries.notes: Self-contained RMLE demo including response sampling for uncertainty propagation.

entries.title: Generate flux spectrum demo
output_paths: unfold result artifact written by the script
entries.notes: Advanced unfolding demo driven by package-bundled Fe-Cd-RAFM-1 inputs.

entries.title: Generate plots demo
output_paths: plot files produced under the script output directory
entries.notes: Advanced plotting demo for publication-style unfolding and covariance visualizations.

entries.title: NJOY processing pipeline demo
input_paths: external NJOY executable if the user wants to run the real processing pipeline
entries.notes: Demonstration of NJOY input generation and workflow specification. Real processing requires an external NJOY installation.

entries.title: Unified nuclear data interface demo
input_paths: script-defined synthetic cross-section grids and identifiers
entries.notes: Demonstrates the unified nuclear-data abstraction layer and temperature-aware data containers.

entries.title: Reactor dosimetry workflow demo
input_paths: script-defined simulated HFIR-like spectrum and dosimetry setup
entries.notes: Large illustrative workflow following the INL flux-wire and spectrum-adjustment sequence.

entries.title: SigPhi saturation-rate demo
input_paths: script-defined irradiation history and monitor measurement
entries.notes: Small self-contained demonstration of saturation-rate and burnup corrections.

entries.title: STAYSL interoperability demo
entries.notes: Creates CSV, matrix, and bundle interoperability artifacts for STAYSL-style workflows.

entries.title: STAYSL reporting demo
input_paths: script-defined synthetic flux, covariance, and cross-section data
output_paths: optional plot files written by the script
entries.notes: Demonstrates differential flux tables, correlation matrices, reporting helpers, and stepwise plotting.

entries.title: TRIGA k0-NAA workflow demo
input_paths: script-defined TRIGA reactor assumptions and illustrative k0 inputs
entries.notes: Detailed worked example for TRIGA-specific Cd-ratio and k0-NAA concepts.

entries.title: Validation attenuation demo
entries.notes: Small validation-oriented attenuation demo using built-in XCOM-backed material helpers.

entries.title: Validation calibration fit demo
input_paths: script-defined synthetic efficiency and resolution points
entries.notes: Small validation demo for detector efficiency and resolution fitting.

entries.title: Validation cross-section demo
entries.notes: Small validation demo for reaction search and cross-section evaluation.

entries.title: Validation IEC reader demo
entries.notes: Reader demo for a user-supplied IEC file; no bundled IEC sample is currently shipped.

entries.title: SpecKit benchmark assets
output_paths: none; this directory currently ships benchmark source assets only
entries.notes: Bundled benchmark inputs for future SpecKit-style comparison work. No direct runner script is shipped in this directory yet.
